title: Sling surgery for urinary incontinence
what: The surgeon places a thin mesh tape under the urethra, the tube that carries urine out. It supports the urethra, so urine does not leak when you cough or strain.
why: For stress incontinence, when urine leaks when you cough, laugh, or jump, and exercises have not helped.
duration: surgery usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; the hospital stay is usually 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. The doctor will tell you what to stop and when
If you had problems with anesthesia

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood and urine tests, and sometimes a bladder function test. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthesiologist
prepare.text: Usually general anesthesia or a numbing injection in the back. The anesthesiologist will talk with you.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually you do not eat or drink for several hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Your things
prepare.text: Comfortable clothes, pads, slippers, and a phone charger.

bring: Things for 1 to 2 days in the hospital
steps: You change, and an IV line is placed in your vein
The surgeon makes a small cut in the vagina and small punctures in the skin
The tape is placed under the urethra
Sometimes a catheter is placed in the bladder for a short time
After surgery, the staff check how you pee
feel: Pain and pulling in the groin and low belly. You will get pain medicine
At first, your urine stream may be weaker
after: Do not lift heavy things for a few weeks
No sex, sauna, or swimming pool. Your doctor will tell you for how long
Try to avoid constipation and hard straining
Come for a follow-up when your doctor says
red_flags: You cannot pee: see a doctor right away
Burning and frequent urges to pee

faq.q: How well does the surgery work?
faq.a: For many women, leaking gets much better or stops. The result depends on the cause.
Yes, it usually stays, and your tissue grows into it.

reminders.text: Surgery tomorrow. Pack your things, documents, and list of medicines. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
